data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking domestic price of Physical Gold
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate returns corresponding to the Domestic Price of Gold beforeexpenses, subject to tracking errors, fees and expenses by investing in Physical Gold. There can be no assurance orguarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Physical Gold & Gold related instruments as may be speciﬁed by SEBI : 95 to 100% Debt and Money Market Instruments,cash and cash equivalents. - 0 to 5%
